item.title: Luna 0.2.1
item.description:
Luna feels more like a Mac app.

  • A new toolbar and window. Glass toolbar, panes you can hide, Split View and full screen. Pick Framed or macOS in Settings.
  • Menus and shortcuts for everything, plus Lock Luna and Help in the menu bar.
  • Undo and Redo when you sort Transactions or work through To check.
  • Files work like Finder. Quick Look a Statement, Reveal in Finder, or drop PDFs on Luna in the Dock.
  • A Dock menu that never shows your money, and clicking the Dock icon brings the window back.
  • Steadier Statements and backups. Merged PDFs read every Statement, and a backup that fails tries again.
  • Accept All only shows on To check.

item.title: Luna 0.2.0
item.description:
The first Luna you install from a download.

  • Luna updates itself. It checks once a day and asks before installing. You can also pick Luna → Check for Updates….
  • Updates never lose your Books. Before a new version opens them, Luna keeps a copy in Before updates, next to your Books.
  • Pick the app icon in Settings → General: one that matches the accent, or one of nine styles. They go dark with your Mac.
